title: LinPipe Models
description: A timestamped index of available LinPipe models, keyed by model name. Same structure as assets.schema.json; each entry additionally summarizes the model-specific fields of its config.

family.description: Copy of the 'family' of the linked config: the model family this model belongs to.

languages.description: Copy of the 'languages' of the linked config: languages the model supports.

operations.description: Copy of the 'operations' of the linked config: kinds of operations the model can respond to.
